items.title: Wine ported to OpenBSD
items.title_zh: Wine 兼容层成功移植到 OpenBSD
items.title_en: Wine compatibility layer ported to OpenBSD
items.summary: Wine has been ported to OpenBSD, bringing Windows application compatibility to the platform and sparking discussion about implementation choices and upstreaming.

items.title: Timestral: Mistral's time-series foundation models
items.title_zh: Mistral 发布 Timestral 时间序列基础模型，支持零样本预测
items.title_en: Mistral launches Timestral, time-series foundation models for zero-shot forecasting
items.summary: Mistral announces Timestral, a family of time-series foundation models supporting covariates and zero-shot forecasting, prompting HN debate on the real utility of generic forecasting models versus per-series baselines.

items.title: Ask HN: How to deal with shipping AI-written code you don't understand?
items.title_zh: Ask HN 热议：如何面对自己并不完全理解的 AI 生成代码
items.title_en: Ask HN: Engineers Struggle With Shipping AI Code They Don't Fully Understand
items.summary: An Ask HN discussion about the discomfort of shipping AI-written code you don't fully understand, with practitioners sharing strategies like designing abstractions yourself, treating LLMs as junior implementers, and investing heavily in testing.

items.title: Datacenters 2027: The Year of Acceleration, +50GW in a Single Year
items.title_zh: SemiAnalysis：2027年数据中心建设将单年新增50GW
items.title_en: SemiAnalysis: 2027 Datacenter Buildout to Add 50GW in One Year
items.summary: SemiAnalysis forecasts a dramatic 2027 datacenter buildout acceleration, citing 60GW under construction and 1.3T in lease contracts, with supply constraints potentially shifting to chips.

items.title: Inception 发布大型扩散式语言模型 Mercury 3，TPS 超过 1k
items.title_zh: Inception 发布扩散式语言模型 Mercury 3，生成速度突破每秒 1000 tokens
items.title_en: Inception launches Mercury 3, a diffusion LLM exceeding 1,000 tokens/sec
items.summary: Inception releases Mercury 3, a diffusion-based LLM claiming over 1000 tokens/sec, 1M token context, and benchmark superiority over GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5.
